claim: Menus poll the keyboard every few frames or run long routines, so short key pulses are missed; hold the key, but held keys can overrun a letter wheel or leak into play.

evidence.text: The menu polls and a short press of J can be missed; two pace seeds with identical numbers meant input was not reaching the game.
The menu checks the keyboard from its interrupt every few frames: a 1-frame press is often missed, in the original too; hold the key.
A sustained press is needed during the long menu beeper routine.
The name screen's wheel of letters: a held key stepped past the end; use short presses with a wait.
A start key still held when play begins reads as input; keep it short.

next_check: Log the keyboard-port reads in a run and report a scripted press shorter than the gap between two reads of its row.
